newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal in 367 bln escudo telecom build by 2000.
newsitem.headline: Portugal in 367 bln escudo telecom build by 2000.

text.p: Portugal's Socialist government plans to invest 367 billion escudos ($2.1 billion) in telecommunications infrastructure by the year 2000, Public Works Minister Joao Cravinho said.
Cravinho told parliament that the state would continue to be a shareholder in Portugal Telecom until 2000 when the telecommunications sector would be liberalised.
"This is a guarantee that investment will be made in infrastructure, which will modernise the telecommunications network and benefit the economy," he said.
